main_body: sci-fi control tower structure with upper observation cabin, central shaft, and lower base building
top_band: upper roof slope/top surface (light blue-grey, rows 8-16) and lower roof surface (paneled blue-grey, rows 51-61)
evidence: Both the upper cabin and lower base clearly show foreshortened top roof planes (rows 8-16 and 51-61) with bright front-edge highlights (rows 15-16, 61), darker eave lines underneath (rows 17, 62-63), and recessed windows and doors on the vertical front faces.

style.evidence: The candidate is enclosed in a heavy, uniform pure-black outline (#000000) giving it a strong sticker look, unlike the reference buildings which use dark material tones. Surfaces (upper roof rows 8-14, central shaft rows 31-50, lower dark walls rows 66-78) consist of large, smooth, untextured flat fills with very low color density compared to the richly textured tiles, plaster, and stonework of the Beodeul references.
